content:
While it started out with digital game deals, PlayStation's full Black Friday sale is now officially live and it contains some accessories and peripheral deals, too. Among the many discounts this year is, of course, DualSense controllers, which have dropped as low as $54.

This price depends on the colorway you choose (and there's a lot of options to look through), but overall each controller is $20 off, which isn't too bad at all if you're in the market for something new. Plus, what better time to pick up a new one than just before GTA 6, right?

Models like the Gray Camouflage, Galactic Purple, and Starlight Blue have hit that $54 price point as part of the sale, but there's also some newer controllers in the mix, like this year's Hyperpop Collection. This line - which comes in Remix Green, Rhythm Blue, and Techno Red - has dropped to $65 in the sale instead, but that's still $20 off their usual MSRP, so still a pretty solid deal to take advantage of.

There's also a couple of limited edition models that have snuck into this sale selection: the shiny golden 007 First Light controller and Marathon's sleek white controller with splashes of neon green. Similar to the Hyperpop Collection, these have dropped to $65 as part of the Black Friday festivities, again saving you $20 off their full price.

If you'd prefer to pick up the DualSense Edge for a little added controller customization instead, you're in luck: both the black and white color variants are on sale for $169 as part of the sale as well. That's a $30 drop from its list price, so it's certainly worth making a move on if you've been hoping to buy it.

Beyond controllers, PlayStation's Black Friday sale is chock-full of discounted goodies to look through. In particular, there are some great physical game deals available, including a price cut on Marvel's Wolverine from Insomniac. There's even a selection of PS5 exclusives marked down to just $30, so it's well worth stocking up on your favorites right now while the sale is still live.
